candidates.name: Rhabdomyolysis
support_spans: Serum creatinine increased to 760.24 µmol/L (8.61 mg/dL)
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with rhabdomyolysis, a condition characterized by muscle breakdown and renal failure.

candidates.name: Acute Tubular Necrosis
support_spans: Urine sediment showed acute tubular necrosis with muddy brown casts
candidates.why: The patient's urinalysis and urine sediment results are consistent with acute tubular necrosis, a condition characterized by damage to the tubules of the kidneys.

candidates.name: Drug-induced Rhabdomyolysis
support_spans: Several weeks after starting a new medication, he experienced decreased appetite, weakness, and fatigue
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms began after starting a new medication, suggesting a potential drug-induced cause of rhabdomyolysis.

candidates.name: Prasugrel-induced Rhabdomyolysis
candidates.why: The patient was taking prasugrel, a medication that has been associated with an increased risk of rhabdomyolysis.
